title: Replacing Handwritten Registers with a Touchscreen POS and Reporting Dashboard
subtitle: From paper tickets to an electronic order-punching system
blurb: Built a desktop touchscreen POS and order-punching system for a pizza restaurant that previously ran entirely on handwritten registers and paper receipts, paired with a live reporting dashboard.
result: Replaced handwritten registers and triple paper receipts with an electronic touchscreen POS and reporting dashboard, now in daily use

meta.solutions: Desktop POS Software, Order Management, Business Dashboard

whoFor: A pizza restaurant running entirely on a manual, old-school register process, with no digital record of orders, sales, or staff activity.
challengeIntro: Every order was handwritten into a physical register, with staff manually creating three separate paper receipts per order: one for the kitchen, one for the owner, and one for the customer. There was no digital record of sales, no way to track cancellations or fulfillment type, and no reporting on revenue or best-selling items.
challengePoints: Orders taken and recorded entirely by hand at a physical register
Three separate handwritten receipts created per order (kitchen, owner, customer)
No way to review past orders by date range or filter by status
No visibility into revenue, canceled orders, or which items were selling best
No system for managing staff or coordinating delivery riders
builtIntro: A touchscreen desktop POS system that digitizes the full order-punching process, paired with a management dashboard covering menu, orders, staff, and reporting.
builtPoints: Automatic receipt printing for kitchen, customer, and owner
Order history with custom date-range filtering (last month, quarter, year, or any custom range)
Order status breakdown by canceled, dine-in, takeaway, and delivery
builtOutro: The system was packaged as a Windows installer and deployed directly onto the client's own machine, replacing the old register process. It is now in active daily use.
